audio.text: If I were you, I'd talk to the advisor before dropping that class.

options: I dropped my phone in class today.
You're right, I don't want to lose my financial aid.

why.en: Agreeing with advice and giving a reason. A uses "dropped" with a different meaning.
why.tr: Tavsiyeye gerekçeli katılım. A "dropped" kelimesini başka anlamda kullanıyor.
why.es: Acepta el consejo y da un motivo. A usa "dropped" con otro significado.
